Name: Maaseiah, Son of Shallum
Summary: Maaseiah, son of Shallum, was keeper of the door of the temple; the chamber of the sons of Hanan was by the chamber of the princes above his chamber, where Jeremiah tested the Rechabites.
KeyStory: Jeremiah brought the Rechabites into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, above the chamber of Maaseiah the keeper of the door, and set wine before them.
RelatedPeople: Zephaniah, Son of Maaseiah; Hanan, Son of Igdaliah
LifeLesson: Even a doorkeeper's chamber can become the room where faithfulness is tested.
